# Svg

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Draws an SVG document as vector content: paths, fills, strokes, gradients, clips and text drawn as glyph outlines, through the same canvas as every other element.

The element sizes its box exactly as [`Image`](image.md) does, from `width`, `height` and the document's intrinsic size under `fitMode`; the document's own `viewBox` and `preserveAspectRatio` then place its content inside that box, as a browser's `<img>` does.

Text uses the fonts registered with BonniePDF, resolved as for a paragraph. Features outside the supported profile (filters, masks, patterns, stylesheets, …) fail generation by default; see `strictUnsupportedFeatures`.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IRoleProvider`, `IAltTextProvider`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new Svg(options?: SvgOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`altText`](#alttext): Alternate text for accessibility.
- [`filePath`](#filepath): Path to an SVG file; Node only (mutually exclusive with `svgData` and `svgGenerator`).
- [`fitMode`](#fitmode): How the drawing fills its box, as for `Image`.
- [`height`](#height): Desired display height in points (undefined = from the document).
- [`isDecorative`](#isdecorative): When `true`, the drawing is decorative and tagged as an artifact, with no alt-text finding.
- [`semanticRole`](#semanticrole): The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. `SemanticRole.H1`, `SemanticRole.P`, `SemanticRole.Figure`).
- [`strictUnsupportedFeatures`](#strictunsupportedfeatures): When `true` (the default), a document using a feature outside the supported profile fails generation, naming every such feature.
- [`svgData`](#svgdata): SVG markup (mutually exclusive with `filePath` and `svgGenerator`).
- [`svgGenerator`](#svggenerator): Produces the markup for the box it is given, in points (mutually exclusive with `svgData` and `filePath`).
- [`width`](#width): Desired display width in points (undefined = from the document).

### `altText`

```typescript
altText: string
```

Alternate text for accessibility. Under PDF/UA-1 it becomes the figure's `/Alt`. When not set, reads as the document's own `<title>`, which is used in its place.

Example, from `industry-templates/healthcare/outpatient-appointment-letter`:

```typescript
map.altText =
```

Example, from `industry-templates/field-service-property/property-particulars`:

```typescript
plan.altText = altText;
```

### `filePath`

```typescript
filePath: string
```

Path to an SVG file; Node only (mutually exclusive with `svgData` and `svgGenerator`).

### `fitMode`

```typescript
fitMode: ImageFitMode
```

How the drawing fills its box, as for [`Image`](image.md). Accepts the enum or a token like `'cover'`.

### `height`

```typescript
height: number | undefined
```

Desired display height in points (undefined = from the document). Accepts a length.

Example, from `code-recipes/page-setup/headers-footers`:

```typescript

```

Example, from `industry-templates/finance-reporting/financial-statement`:

```typescript

```

### `isDecorative`

```typescript
isDecorative: boolean
```

When `true`, the drawing is decorative and tagged as an artifact, with no alt-text finding.

Example, from `code-recipes/page-setup/headers-footers`:

```typescript

```

Example, from `industry-templates/finance-reporting/financial-statement`:

### `semanticRole`

```typescript
readonly semanticRole: SemanticRole
```

*read-only*

The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. [`SemanticRole.H1`](semantic-role.md#h1), [`SemanticRole.P`](semantic-role.md#p), [`SemanticRole.Figure`](semantic-role.md#figure)).

### `strictUnsupportedFeatures`

```typescript
strictUnsupportedFeatures: boolean
```

When `true` (the default), a document using a feature outside the supported profile fails generation, naming every such feature. When `false`, the rest is drawn and each skipped feature is a diagnostic - or, with an SVG rasterizer registered on the document and the async generate path, drawn as an image in its place.

### `svgGenerator`

```typescript
svgGenerator: ((size: SvgSize) => string) | undefined
```

Produces the markup for the box it is given, in points (mutually exclusive with `svgData` and `filePath`). The box cannot come from markup that does not exist yet, so a generator needs both `width` and `height`.

### `width`

```typescript
width: number | undefined
```

Example, from `industry-templates/finance-reporting/financial-statement`:

## Methods

- [`prepare`](#prepare): The synchronous generate paths call this before layout.
- [`prepareAsync`](#prepareasync): Parses the document ahead of layout, rasterizing what the profile cannot draw when a rasterizer is given and `strictUnsupportedFeatures` is off.

### `prepare`

```typescript
prepare(rasterizerRegistered: boolean): void
```

The synchronous generate paths call this before layout. A document that the registered rasterizer would draw differently fails here rather than being drawn without it.

### `prepareAsync`

```typescript
prepareAsync(rasterizer?: SvgRasterizer): Promise<void>
```

Parses the document ahead of layout, rasterizing what the profile cannot draw when a rasterizer is given and `strictUnsupportedFeatures` is off. The async generate paths call this; there is no need to call it yourself.
